verdict.rationale: Trello is a team SaaS product, so organization SSO/SAML is a fair question. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of SAML or enterprise SSO. Google login (trello-comm-15) and organization-managed accounts based on email domain (trello-comm-5, trello-comm-7) are related identity features, not SAML SSO. The API OAuth docs cover developer authorization, not organization sign-in.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
